author: unknown
text_original: अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नवम्यां चैकचेतसः । स्तोष्यन्ति चैव ये भक्त्या मम माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
text_iast: aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ caikacetasaḥ / stoṣyanti caiva ye bhaktyā mama māhātmyamuttamam
verification_source: Ved Path Durga Saptashati chapter 12, liturgical 12.4, https://vedpath.org/en/durga-saptashati/adhyaya-12/
notes: VERIFICATION REVOKED 2026-09-09: GRETIL stoṣyanti vs witness śroṣyanti; substantive lexical difference. Text fields retained verbatim for audit, not harmonized. Former verification claim: Secondary liturgical edition counts devyuvāca separately, so substantive MarkP 92.3 aligns to Ved Path 12.4.

author: unknown
text_original: शरत्काले महापूजा क्रियते या च वार्षिकी । तस्यां ममैतन्माहात्म्यं श्रुत्वा भक्तिसमन्वितः
text_iast: śaratkāle mahāpūjā kriyate yā ca vārṣikī / tasyāṃ mamaitanmāhātmyaṃ śrutvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ
verification_source: Ved Path Durga Saptashati chapter 12, liturgical 12.12, https://vedpath.org/en/durga-saptashati/adhyaya-12/
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment. This supports annual autumn mahāpūjā + hearing the Māhātmya; it does not by itself identify a modern festival name.
